correctness.rationale: Actual RESULT.md proves every uniform fixed-particle-number sector is hopping-invariant by vertexwise divergence-free bias, and homogeneous Langmuir moves reduce the stationary mixture to binomial N and Bernoulli product state. Conditional mean current at N=n is B*n(S-n)/[S(S-1)], giving Cov_pi(j,N)=B*rho(1-rho)(1-2rho). A reaction-event Palm law is uniform over a forced one/zero site plus independent Bernoulli others; mean sector relaxation at rate omega yields K_AJ and K_DJ. For hop before reaction, N is conserved at the hop and mean-reverts under subsequent reaction; applying Cov_pi(j,N) gives K_JA and K_JD. Fubini over distinct event classes gives common integrated formula; signed current and no same-event delta are handled. Independently constructed a complete small finite-state marked generator and evaluated selected ordered kernels by matrix exponential at several lags, matching the four forms; finite tests corroborate the sector proof.
correctness.residual_risks: Only stationary finite connected loopless simple balanced graph with positive uniform Langmuir rates and selected signed oriented edge current. No time-varying rates, open boundaries, full large deviations or unbalanced networks.

Read their primary full HTML arXiv:2405.09261 and companion 2403.01934: neither gives the inspected four event-order cross-covariances or integrated identity on any finite balanced graph. Nearby Resultary hits are unrelated covariance systems. A general marked Markov-process correlation theorem might imply some kernel algebra, but no prior exact specialization found.
